scripts.lint: eslint packages/icons && eslint packages --ignore-pattern packages/icons/ && eslint apps tools && eslint . --ignore-pattern packages/ --ignore-pattern apps/ --ignore-pattern tools/
scripts.e2e:webgpu: bun run build && LTS_WEBGPU_LANE=1 playwright test
scripts.goldens: rm -f e2e/golden/*.png && STILLS_OUT=e2e/golden bun run stills
scripts.e2e:golden: bun run build && LTS_GOLDEN=1 playwright test
scripts.e2e:golden:loose: bun run build && LTS_GOLDEN_LOOSE=1 playwright test
scripts.scenes:generate: bun run build && bun e2e/scenes/generate.ts generate
scripts.scenes:check: bun run build && bun e2e/scenes/generate.ts check
scripts.scenes:plants: bun run build && bun e2e/scenes/generate.ts plants
scripts.scenes: bun run scenes:generate && bun run build && LTS_SCENES=1 LTS_SCENES_UPDATE=1 playwright test
scripts.e2e:scenes: bun run scenes:check && bun run scenes:plants && bun run build && LTS_SCENES=1 playwright test
scripts.e2e:scenes:loose: bun run build && LTS_SCENES_LOOSE=1 playwright test
scripts.forge:test: cd tools/img-to-object/upstream && python3 -m unittest discover -s forge/tests -p 'test_*.py' && cd .. && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
